description: This Java class 'GenericFileFilter' extends 'FileFilter' to provide customizable file filtering based on extensions, including description handling and extension management.

classes.name: GenericFileFilter
classes.description: A file filter class for use with JFileChooser, allowing filtering by file extensions with customizable descriptions.

methods.name: GenericFileFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with a description and extensions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a file is accepted based on being a directory or matching extensions.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a given File object.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the filter's extension list.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the filter, including extensions if configured.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description string for the filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Configures whether extensions are included in the description.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Checks if extensions are included in the description.
